subject: Invitation: Cobalt Health speaker spotlight at Converge.ai Summit (Production LLMs)
messages:
From: Leila Gomez <leila@gatherconvene.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Invitation: Cobalt Health spotlight at Converge.ai Summit — Dec 7

Hi Olga,

Hope you’re well — I run programming for Converge.ai (Dec 6–8, San Jose) and we’re curating a short "Production LLMs: Inference in the Wild" track. We’ve been following Redwood's work with healthcare customers and would love to feature Cobalt Health in a 20-minute customer spotlight + 15-minute fireside discussion.

Specific ask: would someone from Cobalt (product or engineering lead) join a 30–35 minute recorded on-stage session on Dec 7 at 2:00pm PT to walk through the production rollout, operational learnings, and business impact? We can do either a single speaker (customer) + moderator (one of our leads) or a two-person panel (customer + Redwood PM).

Logistics we can cover: A/V, travel stipend, logo placement, and a short pre-event prep call. If you can introduce the customer contact and confirm availability this week, we’ll lock the slot.

Thanks — would love to feature a concrete case study.

Best,
Leila Gomez
Program Director, Converge.ai
leila@gatherconvene.com

Attachment: Converge_Speaker_Guidelines.pdf (stub)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leila Gomez <leila@gatherconvene.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-19T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invitation: Cobalt Health spotlight at Converge.ai Summit — Dec 7

Hi Leila — thanks for the invite, this sounds like a great fit. I spoke with Cobalt today; Aisha Walker (Head of ML Ops) and Dr. Samir Patel (VP Clinical Data) are both open to a short spotlight on Dec 7. They’d prefer a single-customer format plus a Redwood moderator to keep the session tight (10–12 min case + 10–15 min discussion).

Rishi/Marissa — can you help coordinate the PR/ops checklist? Key items we’ll need from Cobalt: speaker bio, logo at 300dpi, a one-slide metrics summary (latency/cost impact if possible), and any redlines about discussing clinical data specifics. I can make the intro if you want me to loop them into this thread.

Leila — if you can confirm the time window (2:00pm PT works preliminarily) and the AV/livestream format, we’ll tee up the customer materials.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-20T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Invitation: Cobalt Health spotlight — logistics + MAP

Nice — I’ll own the mutual action plan for this. Proposed checklist and timeline: 

- Today (Nov 20): Confirm speaker name and short bio (150 words) — Aisha? Samir?
- Nov 22: Customer to send logo, slide with topline metrics, and any compliance redlines
- Nov 24–25: 30-min prep call (talk flow + Qs) — schedule with Leila
- Dec 3: Final slide deck due to organizer; we’ll provide a 2-slide Redwood backdrop
- Dec 6: Travel/A/V check-in; on-site AV contact: Leila to share

Also confirming honorarium: Converge offered travel stipend; if the customer needs anything beyond that (e.g., two pax travel), we can discuss covering incremental travel. Aisha/Samir — let us know your preference.

Attachments (stubs): speaker-draft-talk-outline.docx; A_V_requirements.pdf

Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com

From: Aisha Walker <aisha@cobalt.health>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Leila Gomez <leila@gatherconvene.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invitation: Cobalt Health spotlight at Converge.ai Summit — Dec 7

Hi Olga + Leila,

Thanks for the invitation — happy to participate. I can speak to the deployment story, monitoring/ops, and how inference economics affected our rollout. Samir will join the prep call but I’ll be the on-stage speaker. Dec 7 at 2:00pm PT works.

I’m attaching a short bio and our logo. Please note: we cannot share PHI or any patient-level charts on stage; the metrics slide will be high level (percent improvement in inference throughput and cost per request).

Attachments: Cobalt_Speaker_Bio.docx; logo_cobalt.png

Best,
Aisha Walker
Head of ML Ops, Cobalt Health
aisha@cobalt.health

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Walker <aisha@cobalt.health>, Leila Gomez <leila@gatherconvene.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-05T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invitation: Cobalt Health spotlight — confirmation & next steps

Aisha/Leila — fantastic, thanks for confirming. Quick checklist from our side before the prep call: 

- Rishi will send a brief draft slide template and two talking bullets we’d like to highlight (cost reduction, latency improvements); you’re welcome to edit.
- Marissa will coordinate PR/intro copy and will request a headshot for speaker announcement.
- Can you confirm whether you prefer the intro to mention Redwood by name on-stage? If there are compliance constraints, we’ll keep it muted.

Proposed prep-call windows: Dec 1–2 were tight; can we do Dec 6 at 10:00am PT (30 minutes)? Leila, if that works for you, please send calendar invite with video link.

We’ll forward the draft slide and speaker outline shortly. Looking forward to it — excited to put Cobalt’s story in front of the audience.

Warmly,
Olga

Olga Petrov
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
